cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a penthouse window wall over the city at night — lying on her left side; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — holds a cup at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; A covered landing in a coastal rowing club — She coils a soft training cord in preparation for a practice swim; A glass conservatory propagation table in bright midday light — She opens a soft paper pot and settles a lemon seedling in it; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds a wooden practice sword point-down at her side; a small live house with a low stage — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — writes with a calligraphy brush and an ink stone on rice paper laid flat on the table; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — perched on a ledge or edge; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — seated sideways on a stool or bench; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a Roman marble bath hall — standing
